run.name: Gray Media, Inc
run.title: CP-OS host session (GTN)
run.summary: Gray Media is a heavily levered but liquid local broadcaster: principal debt is 8.28 times last-twelve-months Adjusted EBITDA, interest cover is thin, and no principal falls due before December 2028. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is GRAY MEDIA, INC.

revenue.basis: Total revenue, as the CP-1 table prints it.

ebitda.basis: Adjusted EBITDA, issuer-defined, as the CP-1 table prints it.

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Principal 5,810 and cash 368 over Adjusted EBITDA 670 for FY2025 (C4). 2025 was a political off-year. Same exclusions.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. Adjusted EBITDA 670 over cash interest paid 393 (S-10K page:94); C5.

cash.basis: Cash. Cash at June 30, 2026 and revolver availability of 745 on a 750 commitment (S-Q2-26 page:15). Excludes the receivables facility, which is fully drawn at 400 and gives no availability. Before the July 2026 repurchases, which were funded partly by revolver borrowings of an undisclosed amount.

cashflow.basis: Net cash provided by operating activities, as the CP-1 table prints it.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Governing debt documents, post-June borrowing and the quarter ended September 2026 are not supplied, and Adjusted EBITDA is release-only.
CP-1 main limitation: Adjusted EBITDA is release-only and last twelve months mixes an election-year half with an off-year half; credit agreement terms and post-June borrowing are not supplied.
